prompt: A word's history shown as a chain of stages.
shortDesc: Word origin as a left-to-right chain of stages (oldest first), each with a form and a short note; falls back to a plain paragraph when only text is given.

props.name: stages
props.description: Array of { form, note }, oldest first, e.g. [{ form: 'Sarandīp', note: 'Persian · Sri Lanka' }].

props.name: text
props.description: Plain origin text, used when stages aren't available.

styling.notes: Vellum stage boxes with a rule border, gilt arrows, mono notes.
